title: Xanthe and the Signal
author: Gideon Sandoval
blurb: Bram Ravensworth, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
